name: Corticosteroid-binding globulin deficiency

criteria.description: Markedly decreased serum corticosteroid-binding globulin levels
Normal total serum cortisol concentration despite low CBG
Identification of pathogenic variants in the SERPINA6 gene
Presence of symptoms related to altered free cortisol levels such as fatigue or hypotension

diagnosticCriteria.minimumForDiagnosis: Presence of low serum CBG levels with confirmatory genetic testing identifying SERPINA6 mutations
diagnosticCriteria.notes: Diagnosis requires exclusion of secondary causes of low CBG such as liver disease or acute illness.

pathognomonic.symptomName: Markedly decreased serum corticosteroid-binding globulin concentration
Normal total cortisol with increased free cortisol fraction

laboratory: Normal or slightly decreased total serum cortisol
Elevated free cortisol fraction in plasma
Normal adrenal function tests excluding primary adrenal insufficiency
other: Exclusion of secondary causes of low CBG such as liver disease or acute illness

distinguishingFeatures: Low total and free cortisol levels
Electrolyte abnormalities such as hyponatremia and hyperkalemia
Low CBG due to impaired synthesis

redFlags: Severe hypotension unresponsive to fluid resuscitation
Adrenal crisis-like symptoms despite normal adrenal imaging
Rapid onset of hypoglycemia with altered mental status
